sentences.text: More than 500 parties are contesting the elections South Africans are voting in highly contested local elections likely to see a haemorrhaging of votes for the country's biggest party, the African National Congress (ANC).
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: This year's voting season has been marked by intense campaigns that have included politicians spinning cars, watching grannies knit and even wading through giant-sized potholes.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Election officials say voting is going smoothly, despite long queues at some polling stations.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Leaders are campaigning to head South Africa's nearly 300 municipalities, responsible for basic service provision such as water, electricity and refuse collection.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: For the ANC, the elections are a chance to prove it still has what it takes to govern.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: The party had a disastrous showing in the last national election, when it lost its parliamentary majority for the first time since 1994 when the racist apartheid system ended.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Support for the party has been dropping significantly over the years because of anger over high levels of corruption, unemployment and crime.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: At its peak, in 2004, the ANC got 70% of the vote in the general election.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Two decades later its share dropped to 40%.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Polls and pundits have predicted a further loss in these elections but President Cyril Ramaphosa has denied that his party was in a downward spiral.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: "What I'm seeing here is that the ANC is going higher and higher and on the 4th [of November] we will show those naysayers," he told supporters at the party's final election rally on Sunday.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: In townships like Alexandra, north-east of Johannesburg, the ANC has traditionally had a strong supporter base but poor governance and voter apathy are unravelling this support.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: The BBC visited the sprawling township a week before the elections and spoke to residents to get their views.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: One of them was Sanele Ntombela, who is a first-time voter excited to make his voice heard.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Sanele Ntombela (left), seen here with his friends Tshiamo Mbange (centre) and Lwandle Dladla, is excited to cast his vote We found the 18-year-old hanging out with his friends on a street corner.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Most of his friends said they had no intention of voting and had not registered to do so.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: They cited a lack of change and deteriorating delivery of basic services.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: But Ntombela was looking forward to voting for the first time and thought it might lead to change.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: "We face many challenges in Alexandra.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: There's rubbish everywhere and we struggle with electricity and water and many other issues," he said.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Just metres away, heaps of rubbish lay gathered beneath a streetlight pole covered in election posters from the different political parties.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: On the other side of the street, drain water trickles through the many potholes that have gutted that part of the road.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: The ANC faces immense pressure to reverse years of decline The BBC also spoke to Zandile Mncube, who said she wouldn't vote, even though she is registered to do so.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: The 33-year-old woman also cited poor service delivery and performance by local leaders for her decision.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: "It makes no difference [whether I vote or not].
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Things have gotten worse over the years," she said.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Alex, as the township is known, is a stone's throw away from Sandton, Africa's richest square mile, but the differences could not be starker.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Sandton is known for its skyscrapers, designer shops and well-maintained roads but in Alex, houses are sandwiched together and rubbish, either piled together or left strewn across the pavement, is everywhere.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: The stench of raw sewage and uncollected rubbish is heavy in the air, but residents appear used to it.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: The issues plaguing Alexandra are not unique.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: A drive around Gauteng province reveals similar patterns of neglect and disrepair, especially in the townships.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: South of Johannesburg, Soweto looks marginally cleaner than Alexandra, but residents also complain about service delivery.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Mduduzi Makhubo, 45, has lived in Soweto his entire life and he told the BBC of the community's daily struggles with accessing water and electricity.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: "Every Monday we know we won't have water after 2pm," he said.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Makhubo is registered to vote and intends to use his vote to deal with the "arrogance" he says local leaders have towards residents and "change the status quo".
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Can this man broaden the appeal of a South African party seen by some as 'too white'?
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: South Africa's political marriage of convenience avoids divorce - just These areas offer a small, but important, glimpse into the state of South Africa's local governance.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Years of reports by the auditor-general have highlighted the dire state of most of South Africa's 257 municipalities.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: A recent report only gave 39 clean audits - the highest ranking a public entity can achieve - between 2024 and 2025.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: None of Gauteng's three metro cities, Johannesburg, Tshwane and Ekurhuleni, featured in this list.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Earlier this year auditor-general Tsakani Maluleke said Johannesburg "needs ongoing attention".
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: "If we don't that, we are going to continue on this slide where financial health deteriorates [and] where service delivery continues to be compromised, which is what we are living," she told lawmakers.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: The city has been labelled "effectively bankrupt" due to the dire state of its finances.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Dirty streets, unstable electricity supply and persistent water issues have been common for years.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Experts the BBC spoke to agreed that all eyes will be on Africa's wealthiest city as well as the country's seven other biggest municipalities, or metros, particularly those in Gauteng when the results come in.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Of South Africa's eight metros, only three are governed by a single party.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: In Gauteng, all three metros are governed by coalition governments, with the ANC the largest party.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Political analyst Melanie Verwoerd said the elections would be a "verdict ... and judgment" on the ANC.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: "And the expectation is that the ANC generally in the country is going to [perform] the worst it's ever done," she said.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Several polls point to a continued decline in support for the party in Wednesday's election, contested by over 500 political parties.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: One, conducted by Ipsos, put the ANC's support at 30%, down from the 46% it got at the last local elections in 2021.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: The same poll, along with others, points to a slight increase in electoral support for the Democratic Alliance (DA), especially in Johannesburg.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Ipsos predicts the DA will garner 25% support in this election, up from 22% last time.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: DA leader Helen Zille has been vying for the mayoral chain in the city and her unusual campaign has attracted a lot of attention.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: The former Cape Town mayor has been captured swimming in crater-sized potholes, ziplining over sinkholes and riding into her final rally in the city in a classic BMW 325i, known locally as a "Gusheshe".
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: She believes the DA is the country's best choice for a government, telling local radio broadcaster 702 last week that "towns and cities that work best are under DA governance".
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Verwoerd, a former ANC MP and South Africa's ambassador to Ireland, predicted that coalitions would continue being the order of the day across Gauteng.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: These types of arrangements have often been viewed as unstable and chaotic at a local level and the constant change in leadership, usually caused by parties falling out with each other, has affected service delivery in many municipalities.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Zandile Mncube says things have got worse in her township over the years Verwoerd said in her view, the most stable coalitions would be those that replicate what the ANC and DA have done on a national level, where the historic rivals have agreed to share power.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Reflecting on Cape Town, she said it was unlikely that the DA would lose control of the municipality.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: The coastal city is widely considered the country's best-performing metro and has been run by the DA since the late 2000s when it unseated the ANC.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Ethekwini, which includes the port city of Durban in KwaZulu-Natal, would be a "different story", Verwoerd said.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: The uMkhonto weSizwe (MK) Party has been projected to perform well in the area but it is unclear if it will secure the outright majority needed to run the metro.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Polls suggest it won't and will need partners to form a government.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: The party was founded by former South African President Jacob Zuma and was the biggest party across his home province of KwaZulu-Natal in the 2024 provincial election.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Verwoerd reflected that while various options were on the table for the party, forming a government would be "very messy" given its refusal to work with either the ANC or DA.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: A confident Zuma, addressing supporters on Sunday, vowed to take control of a number of municipalities after the elections.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Another political analyst Dr Levy Ndou echoed Verwoerd's assessment, saying that a coalition between the DA and ANC seemed unavoidable in most metros.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: "We're not sure whether the arrangement of the government of national unity could have the potential to influence how the metros are going to be run," he said.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Both experts also spoke about the declining voter turnout in South Africa's elections.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Over 29 million citizens are registered to vote, but the turnout, especially among young people, has seen a steady decline.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Ndou attributed this to the "calibre" of the candidates campaigning and the lack of visibility of local councillors, who are often the ones elected to lead their neighbourhoods, in election campaigns.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: South Africa's electoral commission has seven days to announce the results, but parties have 14 days to form a governing structure.
sentences.article_title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline

sentences.text: Morocco claims Western Sahara as part of its territory Morocco has welcomed the end of a decades-long UN peacekeeping mission in Western Sahara, after a diplomatic showdown between the US and Russia left the Security Council unable to agree on its future.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: The council failed on Friday to renew the mandate of the UN Mission for the Referendum in Western Sahara (Minurso) after Russia vetoed a US-backed proposal.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: A rival Russian draft to extend the mission also failed to secure enough votes.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: The decision raises questions about the future of Africa's longest territorial dispute and the fragile ceasefire between Morocco, which claims Western Sahara, and the Polisario Front which has been fighting for the territory's independence for more than 50 years.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: Here is what you need to know.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: Western Sahara, on Africa's north-west coast, was a Spanish colony until 1975.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: It has significant phosphate reserves and valuable fishing grounds along its Atlantic coast.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: As Spain prepared to withdraw, both Morocco and Mauritania claimed the territory.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: The International Court of Justice found historical ties of allegiance but no territorial sovereignty that overrode the Sahrawi people's right to self-determination.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: Morocco's then King Hassan II responded by organising the Green March.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: On 6 November 1975 about 350,000 Moroccan civilians entered the territory in a mass demonstration intended to put pressure on Spain.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: Days later, Spain signed the Madrid Accords with Morocco and Mauritania, agreeing to transfer administrative control.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: Morocco took the northern two-thirds and Mauritania the southern third.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: The agreement did not settle the question of sovereignty.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: The Polisario Front, an independence movement founded in 1973, opposed the deal.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: It saw it as replacing Spanish colonial rule with Moroccan and Mauritanian control.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: Mauritania renounced its claim in 1979, but Morocco continued fighting Polisario.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: Algeria became Polisario's main regional ally, providing military support and hosting its leadership and thousands of Sahrawi refugees in camps near the city of Tindouf.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: The North African country says its position is based on the right to self-determination, while Morocco sees Western Sahara as an integral part of its territory.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: Morocco and Algeria fought a brief border war in 1963 over disagreements about territory inherited from French colonial rule.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: Their relationship has remained tense, with Western Sahara at the centre of their dispute.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: After 16 years of fighting, Morocco and Polisario agreed to a UN-brokered ceasefire in 1991, with the territory divided by a sand wall, or berm, to keep the rival forces apart.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: The UN established Minurso to monitor the ceasefire and organise a referendum on the territory's future.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: Sahrawis were meant to choose between independence and integration with Morocco.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: The vote was scheduled for 1992 but never took place.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: The two sides could not agree on who would be eligible to participate, with disputes over voter identification becoming a major obstacle.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: In 2007, Morocco put forward a proposal for autonomy, which would see Sahrawis managing their internal affairs, while Rabat retained control over defence and foreign relations.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: Thousands of Moroccans marched into Western Sahara in 1975 in what became known as the Green March The Polisario Front and Algeria rejected the plan, insisting on a referendum that included independence as an option.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: Years of UN-sponsored negotiations failed to produce a breakthrough.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: The ceasefire broke down in November 2020, when Polisario said it was resuming armed struggle.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: But following a long diplomatic campaign by Morocco, the UN Security Council voted in 2025 in favour of a resolution backing the autonomy plan as the "most feasible" solution for the disputed territory.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: While most Sahrawis live in the part of Western Sahara controlled by Morocco, tens of thousands are estimated to be in refugee camps in Algeria.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: The US proposed extending Minurso's mandate for another year, but its draft went beyond the usual renewal.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: It would have removed the word "referendum" from the mission's name and made Morocco's autonomy proposal the sole basis for further negotiations.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: The draft received the support of 11 of the Security Council's 15 members, including France and the UK but Russia vetoed it, arguing that it was too favourable to Morocco.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: Russia then proposed extending Minurso's mandate without changing its terms.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: That draft also failed, receiving only two votes in favour.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: Minurso's mandate expired at the end of Saturday, 31 October.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: The UN said the following day that the mission had entered a liquidation period, with a reduced team overseeing the transfer of military equipment and other assets.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: The UN mission has been in Western Sahara since 1991 UN Secretary-General António Guterres said the Sahrawi people's right to self-determination must be respected and warned of the risk of renewed hostilities.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: The Polisario Front condemned the US proposal.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: Its representative, Sidi Omar, thanked Russia for vetoing it, saying it would "torpedo the foundations of the UN peace process" and threaten regional and international peace.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: Morocco, meanwhile, said the mission's personnel and equipment should leave the territory in the coming days, arguing that Western Sahara issue should no longer be considered by the Security Council.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: Minurso had 155 military personnel and was expected to cost $62m (£46m) in the financial year beginning in June, according to a UN report.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: Morocco's royal palace welcomed the failure to renew Minurso's mandate.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: In Laayoune, the territory's largest city, footage showed people celebrating, waving Moroccan flags and displaying portraits of King Mohammed VI.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: "The decision is an opportunity for Rabat to challenge what it sees as an international mechanism that has failed to resolve the dispute," Issam Laaroussi, a Moroccan expert in international relations, tells the BBC.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: He said Morocco would now have more room to push its autonomy proposal and shift negotiations away from a referendum on independence towards autonomy under Moroccan sovereignty.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: The decision does not, however, change Western Sahara's legal status or amount to international recognition of Moroccan sovereignty.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: Western Sahara remains on the UN list of non-self-governing territories, while the African Union officially recognises its independence, as the Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic (SADR).
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: But the decision comes after several countries backed the position of Morocco, which in recent years has made securing international support for its claim a central part of its foreign policy.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: In 2020, the US recognised Moroccan sovereignty over Western Sahara as part of an agreement to establish diplomatic relations between Morocco and Israel.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: France also backed Morocco's autonomy plan as the basis for resolving the dispute in 2024.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: Thousands of Sahrawis live in refugee camps in Algeria Morocco rejoined the African Union in 2017, more than three decades after leaving its predecessor, the Organisation of African Unity, in protest at the SADR's admission.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: Since returning, Rabat has sought to build support for its position from within the organisation.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: At least 10 African countries have opened diplomatic missions in the territory in support of Rabat.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: "Morocco is not necessarily seeking to abandon the UN process, but to change the framework for negotiations and draw greater support from regional organisations," says Laaroussi.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: Addressing a special joint session of parliament on Monday, House of Representatives Speaker Ahmed Touizi hailed the end of Minurso as a victory for the country's diplomacy.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: He said the country should now move from "managing the dispute to implementing its autonomy plan under Moroccan sovereignty, while pressing ahead with development projects in the territory." The fear is that Minurso's departure could lead to renewed fighting.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: The mission has monitored military developments and helped reduce the risk of escalation.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: Aid organisation Oxfam warned that losing its monitoring and de-escalation role could undermine stability, with serious consequences for civilians.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: Laaroussi admits that the mission's departure could create security gaps.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: "Minurso's departure does not create the original conflict, because the conflict is already there, but it could aggravate an already fragile security environment," he says.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: The UN decision has also fuelled nationalist rhetoric online.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: Several Moroccan users have shared AI-generated images of themselves in military uniform, declaring their readiness to fight for Morocco's sovereignty over Western Sahara.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: In Morocco, Western Sahara is widely regarded as a national cause.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: Political parties that are often divided on other issues are united in supporting the country's claim to sovereignty over the territory.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: Foreign Minister Nasser Bourita has said the end of the mission does not mean the end of the ceasefire, and that Rabat remains committed to it "within respect of its security and sovereignty." Polisario has not said what it will do next.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: Any resumption of fighting could well draw in Algeria, as tensions with Morocco remain high.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: According to the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute (SIPRI), both countries significantly increased military spending last year, with SIPRI citing their dispute over Western Sahara as a key driver.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: Algeria spent an estimated $25.4bn, more than four time Morocco's $6.3bn.
sentences.article_title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating

sentences.text: Morocco wants tourists to visit Western Sahara.

sentences.text: Lula's supporters mobilised en masse despite polls pointing to a defeat for the incumbent A WhatsApp channel created to support Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's re-election campaign is being credited by allies with helping deliver one of the most unlikely comebacks in recent Brazilian politics.

sentences.text: Brazil's left-wing president had been trailing right-wing challenger Flávio Bolsonaro, but managed to turn the race around in just three weeks.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: At a moment when many doubted Lula could reverse the result, a WhatsApp channel called Lula's Army emerged, and rapidly grew to 10.8 million followers.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: Led by Congressman André Janones, the operation encouraged supporters to share videos, promote hashtags and recruit new voters.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: Its dramatic growth between the two rounds was particularly notable because it appeared to reverse a long-standing imbalance in Brazilian politics.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: For years, conservatives aligned with former President Jair Bolsonaro had been widely seen as dominating online political mobilisation, especially on platforms such as WhatsApp and Telegram.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: Lula called André Janones "our General" after his major contribution paid off The emergence of Lula's Army convinced many supporters that Brazil's left had finally found a way to compete in a digital arena.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: The shift was particularly significant because social media has played a central role in Brazilian politics since Jair Bolsonaro's 2018 election victory, when WhatsApp networks became a defining feature of political campaigning.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: Lula's Army messages often included ready-made templates for followers to share with friends and family.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: Each one assigned supporters a specific task aimed at boosting Lula's visibility on social media.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: Janones frequently instructed his "troops" to "blow up" the latest campaign video or help a new hashtag "take off".
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.text: "Guys, urgent!", "Don't go to sleep yet", "No food before the mission!", and "I have one more task before you're dismissed", were some of the instructions.

sentences.text: Rather than relying solely on online engagement, she says the Workers' Party candidate succeeded in connecting digital campaigning with grassroots mobilisation on the ground.
sentences.article_title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around

sentences.article_title: Anthony Zurcher: Midterm carnage weakens Trump but he still wields power for now

sentences.text: And the biggest obstacles may come from within Trump's own ranks.
sentences.article_title: Anthony Zurcher: Midterm carnage weakens Trump but he still wields power for now

sentences.text: For two years the president has displayed a vice-like grip on the Republican Party, keeping his partisan rank and file in Congress and across the US in line through a combination of political rewards and bare-knuckle threats.
sentences.article_title: Anthony Zurcher: Midterm carnage weakens Trump but he still wields power for now

sentences.text: Now, however, there are signs that his hold may be loosening.
sentences.article_title: Anthony Zurcher: Midterm carnage weakens Trump but he still wields power for now

sentences.text: Some Republicans have begun showing a willingness to criticise his decisions in a way few would dare even a few months ago.
sentences.article_title: Anthony Zurcher: Midterm carnage weakens Trump but he still wields power for now

sentences.text: His own vice-president, JD Vance, penned a lengthy post on social media blaming the war in Iran that Trump launched with Israel for Tuesday's sweeping Republican defeat.
sentences.article_title: Anthony Zurcher: Midterm carnage weakens Trump but he still wields power for now

sentences.text: "If you'd like to argue it was worth it, that losing the Senate for the next six years was worth it, then do so," Vance wrote.
sentences.article_title: Anthony Zurcher: Midterm carnage weakens Trump but he still wields power for now

sentences.text: "But everyone knows why we lost.
sentences.article_title: Anthony Zurcher: Midterm carnage weakens Trump but he still wields power for now

sentences.text: According to BBC US media partner CBS News, the president is asking close advisers whether he should replace Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, one of the architects of the war.
sentences.article_title: Anthony Zurcher: Midterm carnage weakens Trump but he still wields power for now

sentences.text: Such a move would echo George W Bush's move to replace Donald Rumsfeld, a driving force behind the Iraq war, in response to his 2006 "thumping" – the last time Democrats won congressional majorities of Tuesday's scope in a midterm election.
sentences.article_title: Anthony Zurcher: Midterm carnage weakens Trump but he still wields power for now

sentences.text: Then on Wednesday, as construction workers raised the final beam for the White House ballroom he is building despite a lawsuit attempting to halt its progress, he responded to a few questions about the political future.
sentences.article_title: Anthony Zurcher: Midterm carnage weakens Trump but he still wields power for now

sentences.text: "I'll get along probably with the Democrats, unless they want to be destructive," he said.
sentences.article_title: Anthony Zurcher: Midterm carnage weakens Trump but he still wields power for now

sentences.text: "But I have the power of the veto." In 1995, months after Republicans took control of Congress in a wave election that left Democrats similarly reeling, an isolated and defensive President Bill Clinton insisted that he still mattered and that he had powers left to wield.
sentences.article_title: Anthony Zurcher: Midterm carnage weakens Trump but he still wields power for now

sentences.text: "The president is still relevant here," he said, plaintively.
sentences.article_title: Anthony Zurcher: Midterm carnage weakens Trump but he still wields power for now

sentences.text: Clinton, still in his first term, had time to rebound politically – and he won re-election the following year.
sentences.article_title: Anthony Zurcher: Midterm carnage weakens Trump but he still wields power for now

sentences.text: Time, however, is not on Trump's side.
sentences.article_title: Anthony Zurcher: Midterm carnage weakens Trump but he still wields power for now

sentences.text: With Republicans licking their wounds, he may try to make a similar argument to the powers in Washington and the American public.
sentences.article_title: Anthony Zurcher: Midterm carnage weakens Trump but he still wields power for now

sentences.text: But with each passing day, the man who loves to dominate the spotlight in US politics may find his powers – and, more importantly, his authority to wield them – slipping through his fingers.
sentences.article_title: Anthony Zurcher: Midterm carnage weakens Trump but he still wields power for now

sentences.article_title: Five reasons why Republicans lost so badly

sentences.text: While the incumbent president's party generally tends to have a bad night in these elections, the scale of the Republican defeat is being viewed as a resounding rejection of Donald Trump's two years in the White House.
sentences.article_title: Five reasons why Republicans lost so badly

sentences.text: From angry voters to an unpopular president , here are five reasons why the Republicans lost so many seats .
sentences.article_title: Five reasons why Republicans lost so badly

sentences.text: From coast to coast, voters across the US have been grappling with the soaring cost of essentials.
sentences.article_title: Five reasons why Republicans lost so badly

sentences.text: That anger was palpable on the ground in key races.
sentences.article_title: Five reasons why Republicans lost so badly

sentences.text: "Gas prices, grocery prices, everything's going up," one North Carolina voter told the BBC ahead of the elections, adding that she had switched her vote from Republican to Democratic this election.
sentences.article_title: Five reasons why Republicans lost so badly

sentences.text: Prices increased by 3.7% in the year to September, driven higher by fuel and energy prices.
sentences.article_title: Five reasons why Republicans lost so badly

sentences.text: Average US retail diesel prices in early October were just shy of the record of $6.52 (£4.83) per gallon seen in September, according to government data.
sentences.article_title: Five reasons why Republicans lost so badly

sentences.text: Almost eight in 10 voters (79%) said inflation had caused them and their family a severe or moderate hardship in the past year, according to data from voter polls.
